title: Triangle Strategy
subtitle: A political choice becomes a battlefield
summary: Triangle Strategy is Square Enix and Artdink's tactical role-playing game, first released for Switch on 4 March 2022.
body: Triangle Strategy is Square Enix and Artdink's tactical role-playing game, first released for Switch on 4 March 2022. The struggle among Norzelia's powers places Serenoa Wolffort and his companions between political demands and the consequences of their decisions. Battles use small character figures across detailed HD-2D terrain, while conversations and investigations give the next confrontation its context. The campaign asks the player to understand both kinds of position: where a unit stands on a battlefield and where its allies stand on the choice that leads there.

Height, direction and cooperation influence attacks. Placing allies on opposite sides of an opponent can trigger a follow-up strike, and approaching from above or behind increases the advantage. Terrain also supports elemental interactions: water can extend lightning, fire can hinder a route, and wind can push an enemy towards a drop. Each character has a distinct role and rechargeable Tactical Points for abilities. The player builds a plan from those relationships, treating the map as an active part of the encounter rather than a surface on which units merely wait.

At major decisions, the group consults the Scales of Conviction and votes on a course of action. Exploring and gathering information can help persuade a companion before that vote, connecting quieter scenes to the route taken by the story. Branches alter events and available allies before leading towards the campaign's endings. Akira Senju composed the score. The game gives tactical preparation a narrative counterpart: success depends on learning about the situation, understanding another character's position and making a choice whose effects continue into the next stage of the journey.
